chunks: Ahmad ibn Ali al-Razi, from Muhammad ibn Ali, from Hanzalah ibn Zakariya, who said: The trustworthy one narrated to me, from Muhammad ibn Ali ibn Bilal, from Hakimah, an identical tradition.

key_terms.الثِّقَةُ: The trustworthy one (a specific narrator or title used in Shia hadith literature)
key_terms.بِمِثْلِ ذَلِكَ: An identical tradition / similar to that
key_terms.حَنْظَلَةُ بْنُ زَكَرِيَّا: Hanzalah ibn Zakariya (a prominent companion of the Imams)

ai.seo_question: Who is the source of the narration regarding the birth of Imam al-Mahdi in Tusi's Kitab al-Ghayba?
ai.summary: This concise narration from Shaykh al-Tusi’s *Kitab al-Ghayba* serves as a critical link in the *tawatur* (mass transmission) of Imam al-Mahdi’s birth, emphasizing the reliability of the chain through Hanzalah ibn Zakariya, a key companion of the Imams. By citing Hakimah with an identical report, the text underscores the consistency of early Shia sources regarding the timing and legitimacy of the Twelfth Imam’s entry into the world during the Abbasid era.
